_comment: Default parameters for exosuit_sim. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored. ALL suit and actuator values are ILLUSTRATIVE, not measured or flight specifications. Relative paths resolve from the working directory.
description: Knee flexion 0->90 deg in 1.0 s, lunar gravity, illustrative hysteretic suit, constrained actuator

environment._units: gravity in m/s^2 (Earth 9.81, Mars 3.71, Moon 1.62, orbit 0)
environment.label: lunar surface

anthropometry._source: Segment ratios approximately follow Winter (2009), Biomechanics and Motor Control of Human Movement; verify against the source. Lengths are illustrative.

trajectory._units: angles in degrees, duration of one phase in s; mode 'flexion' or 'flexion_extension'

baseline_torque._options: source 'inverse_dynamics' (synthetic, physics-based) or 'csv' (columns knee_flexion_deg, knee_torque_Nm; PCHIP interpolation)

spacesuit._model: tau_suit = E(phi)(1 + h s) + tau_f s,  E = k1 phi + k2 phi|phi|  (phi in rad). ILLUSTRATIVE coefficients.

actuator._units: torque N*m, force N, moment arm m, torque rate N*m/s (null disables), efficiencies 0..1. ILLUSTRATIVE limits.

optimization._weights: dimensionless after normalisation by torque_scale_Nm (null = peak suit torque); only ratios matter

sensitivity._note: one-at-a-time sweeps around the defaults; ILLUSTRATIVE ranges
